title: MLS Top-Selling Jerseys of 2026
scope: Player jersey sales on the official MLS online store (MLSstore.com) from January 1 to October 30, 2026.
methodology: MLS published the top 10 by sales on its online store. Unit counts are not published.
limitations: Covers sales on the MLS online store only; other retailers and in-stadium sales are not included.
The 2025 list was announced in MLS's season review without naming the retailers covered, so the two lists are not compared rank by rank.
MLSsoccer.com does not print a date on the article; the Nov. 3, 2026 date comes from same-day coverage by ESPN and Yardbarker.
periodLabel: MLS Store sales, January 1 to October 30, 2026
